summary:
Reviewed by a separate subagent.
Adds a self-updater: a daily background check through the launcher installs a newer npm release only after offline Sigstore verification of this repo's release workflow, into immutable runtime folders switched by one record file under a loopback-port lock. Also adds a stub user-scope skill, Claude Code allow rules, a team section in the repo's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, a four-command help menu and a release step that moves the v0 tag. Reviewed twice: the first brief (667db30ba5e8) moved while the author edited the worktree; five findings from it (Cursor rule not counted as a launcher user, team-section hint that did not work, update.json rewritten after uninstall, a failed cache write reported as a failed switch, the finalize handoff with --) are fixed in this version and not raised again.

findings.title: Temp runtime folders left behind forever
findings.description: When the 10 minute deadline calls process.exit(2), or the worker is killed, during unpack or activation, `<home>/runtime/<version>.tmp-<pid>/` (the tarball plus the unpacked package) is never removed: pruneRuntimes only matches plain x.y.z names and uninstall only removes ourRuntimes, so the folder stays and also keeps `runtime/` from being removed on uninstall. Remove `*.tmp-<pid>` folders whose pid is not alive in pruneRuntimes and in uninstall.

findings.title: v0 tag moved by any major version
findings.description: The step moves v0 for every published version, so the first 1.0.0 release force-moves `openqodex/openqodex@v0` onto a breaking major for every Action user. Derive the tag from the major, or refuse to move v0 when the major is not 0.
findings.suggested_change:
major="v${version%%.*}"
          git tag -f "$major"
          git push --force origin "refs/tags/$major"

findings.title: README omits 0.2.1 from the versions that need one init
findings.description: 0.2.1 is the current published release and has no self-updater, yet the README names only 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 as needing one `npx openqodex init` to start updating, so a 0.2.1 user reads that they update on their own. Say 'before 0.3.0' instead of listing versions.
findings.suggested_change: These do not update: files committed with `init --project`, the review section `init` adds to a repository's `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`, the skill from `npx skills add`, the GitHub Action pin, and machines that are offline or stop background processes. An active install is usually one to two days behind a release. An install made before 0.3.0 needs one `npx openqodex init` to start updating.

findings.title: --yes description contradicts the team section order
findings.description: knownTeamChoice now lets --yes override a recorded no for the team section (and docs/agents.md says so), but this line says --yes adds the team section 'unless this repository answered no before'. That is still true for the pre-push hook only. Split the sentence so each answer is described as the code applies it.
findings.suggested_change: - `--yes`, `-y`: do not ask; add the pre-push hook unless this repository answered no before, and add the team review section even if it did. Without a terminal, `init` needs this flag.
